resources.string: No obvious overlaps found. Custom JSON and complex address/rule-set conditions require runtime verification.
Require a usable reply from the configured remote DNS and a verified HTTPS response. Up to 18 seconds per node; three concurrent checks.
Enter an HTTPS URL without credentials or a fragment.
After three failed checks, pause retries for 30 seconds to 10 minutes. Retry on the next scheduled check. Reset results when the network changes.
